expected_behavior: Alarming wording (security alert, sign-in) but a legitimate sender and link on github.com. Verdict likely safe (false-positive check).
Legitimate non-English (Finnish) mail from hamk.fi with a deadline. Not flagged as phishing just because of the language. Verdict likely safe.
Empty input is rejected with the message 'Paste an email or upload an .eml file to start.' No verdict, no crash, no raw error.
Plain text that is not an email ('hello') is handled in a controlled way: rejected with a friendly message or analysed with a no-headers warning. No crash, no raw error.
Urgent-sounding password-expiry notice from the real hamk.fi that says no password is requested by email. Verdict likely safe or at most suspicious, never phishing.
